risk_note: RV2 (content + platform/media; home popup assets, BR-TEXT-26, contract CT-07b #1091, rulings D10-126). POST /admin/v1/pages/popup-assets (permission content.page, no step-up): kind lottie checks size <= 307200 bytes, JSON object with v / fr / ip / op / w / h / layers, exact duration (op - ip) / fr in (0, 3] seconds, assets[].p must be a data: URI (u is not used); kind image accepts png / jpeg by magic bytes up to 1 000 000 bytes; rejections are 20001 fields=[file] (or [kind]) with reason format / too_large / too_long / external_ref; accepted files go to the MediaStore under their SHA-256 (MediaStore now also takes application/json and image/jpeg), the same content returns the same url, the upload changes no page and audits only kind / sha256 / bytes. Page save and publish check popup.lottie only by reference (media url whose file name equals sha256). The admin multipart limits are widened for this one request inside the content controller (a TODO asks for per-route limits in bootstrap). Rule tests by Codex in 3 attempts (D10-126); two mechanical test commits (kit Buffer type, bigint replacer). Test-machine full verify passed. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
